text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x, y) ::: y binge-watches x.
Download(x, y) ::: y downloads x.
Share(x, y) ::: y shares x.
Show(x) ::: x is a show.
BlackMirror ::: "Black Mirror"
Karen ::: Karen
Lisa ::: Lisa

Premises:
Show("Stranger Things") ∧ Show("Black Mirror") ::: "Stranger Things" and "Black Mirror" are shows.
Popular("Stranger Things") ::: "Stranger Things" is a popular Netflix show.
∀x (Popular(x) → BingeWatch(karen, x)) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
∀x (BingeWatch(x, y) → Download(y, x)) ::: If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will download it.
¬Download("Black Mirror", karen) ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
∀x (BingeWatch(x, "Black Mirror") → Share(x, lisa)) ::: If Karen binge-watches "Black Mirror", she will share it with Lisa.

Conclusion:
BingeWatch("Stranger Things", karen) ::: Karen will binge-watch "Stranger Things".
Share("Stranger Things", lisa) ::: Karen will share "Stranger Things" with Lisa.
